annotations.title: Create and register an Achromat identity

description: achromat_recall already works without an identity. An identity is needed only for achromat_calibrate (checking a call against live policy, which is how new lessons are made) and to see the user's own pending lessons. This tool creates one: it generates an Ed25519 key pair, completes a short proof of work (about a second), registers the public key with Achromat Machine Operational Memory, and saves the private key to a file that only this user can read. ASK THE USER FIRST and wait for a yes, because it writes a private key file on their machine and creates an identity on the service. Explain that the key never leaves the machine, that only the public half is sent, and that the file cannot be recovered if lost. Then call this tool with user_confirmed set to true. Afterwards achromat_calibrate becomes available and achromat_recall signs its requests.

user_confirmed.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has said yes to creating an identity. If they have not been asked, ask first and do not call this tool.
